policy: Asset authoring method is chosen per Item. HERO assets require independent source files when clean isolation/animation matters.

candidates.purpose: Test whether one high-detail engraving sheet could supply multiple isolated production assets.

generation.prompt_summary: High-detail 19th-century gothic engraving asset sheet with creature, scientist, hand, window, laboratory table, apparatus and props.

findings.reason: Overlapping collage layout prevents reliable alpha-safe extraction of several HERO elements.

candidates.decision: Do not use the sheet as the canonical source for HERO assets. Regenerate/acquire hero elements individually.

derived_assets.authoring_method: manual crop + alpha isolation + JavaScript lighting/compositing
derived_assets.findings: Major visual improvement versus primitive body. Suitable for wide-shot subtle motion. Not sufficient for independent limb convulsion.

derived_assets.authoring_method: manual isolated full-body figure + JavaScript crop/lighting
derived_assets.findings: Substantially improves period silhouette/anatomy. Needs a purpose-built hand/door interaction asset for the close-up.

derived_assets.authoring_method: manual isolated head/profile + JavaScript shadow mask
derived_assets.findings: Much stronger anatomical/engraving quality than primitive head. Still needs a purpose-built eye crop and cleaner alpha edges for final.
Raises historical/detail quality, but interaction/contact hand remains the weak link.

derived_assets.authoring_method: manual isolated architectural fragment + JavaScript glow/parallax
derived_assets.findings: Strong focal architecture. Source-sheet edge contamination still needs a cleaner individually authored final asset.

blockers: clean individual HERO source assets rather than sheet-derived contamination
creature articulated limb solution if convulsion is shown clearly
apparatus contact composition needs another pass
